valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; its own 12.5x sits just below the median
points: Comparable deals (70) price at 10.7x (25th percentile), 12.8x median and 15.3x (75th percentile) [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin is above the comparable median of 12.9%, supporting the 75th percentile; this buyer's median paid is 12.5x [V:comps].
Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M (cost synergies of 3-5% of implied opex, half realised); buyer revenue not researched, so capacity is unconfirmed [V:synergy].
